ai/npc/Trainers/HealerTrainer/30117.html.text: Priest Primoz: Welcome to the temple of Einhasad! Giran is more peaceful and prosperous than ever before. But we must be wary of the forces of evil that seek to destroy the virtuous -- especially in times like these! Only the holy light of the goddess can withstand the rising tide of darkness.

Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!
